The '''Jumpstar hyperdrive generator''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and sold for 6400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTE core rulebook" />
